name: Being A Good Witness
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively bear witness to Christ through both their actions and words, reflecting His light so that others may glorify God (Matthew 5:16). The Great Commission commands followers to preach the gospel to all people everywhere (Mark 16:15), empowered by the Holy Spirit to be effective witnesses locally and globally (Acts 1:8). Being a good witness involves boldly sharing what we have seen and heard of Christ (Acts 22:15) without shame, recognizing the gospel as the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes (Romans 1:16). This witness is grounded in the reality that all have sinned and need redemption (Romans 3:23), making the gospel message essential for every hearer.
